standard_prerequisites.name: The behaviour of closures under a continuous map and closedness of the map, together with the notion of submersiveness
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Set up in the author's section on submersive maps, immediately before the counted statement
standard_prerequisites.use: Fixes the four assertions and the closing claim that the map is submersive.

core_obligations: Part (1): from the inclusion of the closure of the preimage in the preimage of the closure the proof obtains that the image of that closure is a closed set sandwiched between T and its closure, which forces equality (proof lines 815-817).
Part (2): closedness of subsets of the target is read off from closedness of the map and surjectivity (proof lines 817-820).
Parts (3) and (4): openness and local closedness follow by complementation and by restricting to the closure of the preimage, as in the open version of the lemma (proof lines 820-825).
Conclusion: the four assertions and submersiveness of the map (proof line 825).
proof_roadmap: (1) 由 cl(f^{-1}T) ⊂ f^{-1}(cl T) 得 f(cl(f^{-1}T)) 是夹在 T 与 cl T 之间的闭集，故相等。
(2) 由 f 闭且满射直接得；(3)(4) 用补集与限制到 cl(f^{-1}T) 上，写法与开映射版平行，最后得 f 是 submersive。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement is the closed-map companion of the open-map lemma (author lemma at source lines 800-812, label lemma-closed-morphism-quotient-topology): for a surjective closed continuous map, the closure of a subset of the target is the image of the closure of its preimage, and closedness, openness and local closedness are tested on preimages, so the map is submersive. The proof (source lines 814-826) runs the same scheme as the open version but with the sandwich argument in part (1), where the image of the closure of the preimage is trapped between T and its closure (proof lines 815-817), and then derives the remaining parts by complementation and restriction (proof lines 817-825). H2.
